div.div: 1 سَخَبٌ [inf. n. of سَخِبَ] i. q. صَخَبٌ [inf. n. of صَخِبَ], (A, K,) signifying The raising a loud cry, or a clamour: (TA:) or it [is used as a subst., and] signifies a confusion of sounds. (Mgh, MF, TA.) The substitution of س for ص is allowable in every word containing خ: [for instance,] in a trad. [cited voce خَشَبٌ, q. v., as some relate it], the hypocrites are described as خُشُبٌ بِاللَّيْلِ سُخُبٌ بِالنَّهَارِ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
